# Mage Arena chamber

Below the Mage Arena; areas/area_mage_arena/scripts/chamber.rs2 places the god capes here. Its cellar, with the bank and the rune shop, is the landing of the ladder in the Mage Arena house at (3091, 3957) (oploc1,magearena_ladder_to_cellar, areas/area_mage_arena/scripts/mage_arena.rs2:1, the move at :6), a script outside ladders+stairs/ and so no connector row; the god statues and the staff shop beyond are the sparkling pool's (oploc1,magearena_waterportal1 at (2541, 4719), mage_arena.rs2:15) once the Mage Arena miniquest is done. So the world index's walk from the Lumbridge spawn, which reaches the ladder with no requirement, does not reach the cellar, its bank or the shops (build.ts unreached report).
